announcements.headline: Director Dealing
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that a director has engaged in a transaction involving the company's shares. Such filings are routine regulatory disclosures that confirm insider activity but do not inherently signal a change in corporate strategy or financial performance.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM, Share Consolidation and TVR
AGM Notice, Share Consolidation & Warrant Exercise
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a scheduled general meeting alongside structural capital changes involving share consolidation and warrant exercise. These actions typically alter the number of shares in issue and may affect liquidity or voting power without indicating immediate operational performance.

announcements.headline: Issue of CSOP Options
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the grant of share options to individuals, typically directors or employees, which may lead to future dilution of existing shareholdings upon exercise.

announcements.headline: Audited results for the year ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of audited annual financial results, which is a scheduled regulatory event providing shareholders with verified performance data for the period ended 31 March 2026.
